You are a programming expert. 
        You will be provided with a patch used to fix a bug. 
        Based on the commit message and modifications in the patch, you need to analyze the root cause of the bug in detail. 

        Here is the patch content:
        From ecc7b435d2beb025d7506af74cf749af2cef5734 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Eryu Guan <eguan@redhat.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Jul 2017 13:32:32 +0800
Subject: [PATCH] nfs: count correct array for mnt3_counts array size

Array size of mnt3_counts should be the size of array
mnt3_procedures, not mnt_procedures, though they're same in size
right now. Found this by code inspection.

Fixes: 1c5876ddbdb4 ("sunrpc: move p_count out of struct rpc_procinfo")
Cc: Christoph Hellwig <hch@lst.de>
Signed-off-by: Eryu Guan <eguan@redhat.com>
Reviewed-by: Christoph Hellwig <hch@lst.de>
Signed-off-by: Anna Schumaker <Anna.Schumaker@Netapp.com>
---
 fs/nfs/mount_clnt.c | 2 +-
 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+), 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/fs/nfs/mount_clnt.c b/fs/nfs/mount_clnt.c
index 3efe946672be..60bad882c123 100644
--- a/fs/nfs/mount_clnt.c
+++ b/fs/nfs/mount_clnt.c
@@ -512,7 +512,7 @@ static const struct rpc_version mnt_version1 = {
 	.counts		= mnt_counts,
 };
 
-static unsigned int mnt3_counts[ARRAY_SIZE(mnt_procedures)];
+static unsigned int mnt3_counts[ARRAY_SIZE(mnt3_procedures)];
 static const struct rpc_version mnt_version3 = {
 	.number		= 3,
 	.nrprocs	= ARRAY_SIZE(mnt3_procedures),
-- 
2.25.1


        
        Provide a response strictly in the following format:
        Root cause:<Root cause>

Root cause: The bug was caused by using the wrong array for the size of the `mnt3_counts` array. Instead of using the size of the `mnt_procedures` array, the correct size should have been based on the `mnt3_procedures` array. Although both arrays currently have the same size, relying on the wrong array could lead to inconsistencies and potential bugs in the future if sizes were to diverge. This issue was identified through code inspection, leading to the necessary correction in the patch.

Instead of using the size of the `mnt_procedures` array, the correct size should have been based on the `mnt3_procedures` array. Although both arrays currently have the same size, relying on the wrong array could lead to inconsistencies and potential bugs in the future if sizes were to diverge.
